title: Version of New York?
content: I frequently dream of a city. I have to take a plane to get there, and every time I get on, I realize there are no windows and it feels like the plane will crash. I try to get off but they won't let me; the flight is really long and I always have a huge feather pillow, like a body pillow, with me. Then I'm at my hotel and there's a lot of red and black Victorian style decor. I walk outside to go to this certain retail area-I hesitate to call it a mall, there are parts that are inside and parts that are outside. The outside parts are in a labyrinthine space full of small intimate streets and alleys with the occasional open area but there are no cars and you have to walk it. It's really interesting and there's lots of colorful murals, decorative architecture, art, etc but its all very muted, like the colors are vibrant but covered with a fine mist or cloth. Every time I go everything has just closed for the day and it's deserted but I enjoy looking anyway. The inside part is kind of like a super sized Costco/ restaurant supply/ gourmet food store. it's huge, and they have things from different countries like ham from Spain, cheese from France, Swiss chocolate, on and on; then there's the freezer section with whole sides of beef, the supply with all kinds of pots, pans, utensils and appliances ( stoves, ovens, blenders, fryers, etc.) And a produce area that has every kind of exotic fruit and vegetable you could ever imagine. It's really fun to look but I can never buy anything there either. I have other locations I go to but everywhere I go it's always closed. I'll put those in a different post because this already feels long but I'd like to know if anyone else has experienced everything being shut down in their dream?
